Method of Attack: Automatically identify security vulnerabilities related to the (mis)use of attacker-controlled non-volatile memory trusted by the bootloader’s code
Allow attacker to execute arbitrary code as part of the bootloader, compromising the entire chain of trust
Leverage vulnerabilities by an attacker with root privileges on the OS to unlock the device and break the Chain of Trust (CoT)
Discoverer: University of California, Santa Barbara research team
Impacted Systems: Android bootloaders from Huawei / HiSilicon chipset (Huawei P8 ALE-L23)
Date of Discovery: 2023 (research presented earlier this month at USENIX conference in Vancouver, Canada)
